WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM t) targeted, (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN h USING(member_id)) overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) rows_,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT exposure_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) dist_exp_ids,
 (SELECT min(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) mn,
 (SELECT max(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) mx,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT exposure_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_ids_all,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=t.member_id WHERE m.is_current AND NOT m.marketing_consent) nonconsent_now

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN member_key IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) memlines
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-10' AND DATE '2025-12-07'

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) web_orders,
 min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) mind, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) maxd
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-14' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
member_lines AS (
  SELECT dm.member_id, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL
    AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)),
spend AS (SELECT member_id, SUM(net_amount) AS spend FROM member_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07' GROUP BY 1),
grp AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' g FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout)
SELECT g.g, count(*) members, sum(coalesce(sp.spend,0)) total, avg(coalesce(sp.spend,0)) mean_spend, count(sp.member_id) buyers
FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend sp USING(member_id) GROUP BY 1

SELECT 'exposures to version without consent' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND NOT m.marketing_consent
UNION ALL
SELECT 'exposure version not valid at contact date', count(*), count(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key
WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND NOT (CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', e.contact_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'targeted joined after 2025-11-30', count(*), count(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND m.join_date > DATE '2025-11-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'holdout joined after 2025-11-24 or no consent', count(*), count(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-11-24'
WHERE h.campaign_id=15 AND (m.join_date > DATE '2025-11-24' OR NOT m.marketing_consent)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'holdout members with valid version at 24 Nov', count(*), count(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id=h.member_id AND m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-11-24' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-11-24' WHERE h.campaign_id=15
